_comment: What narration may not contain, because the TTS reads the file aloud. The worker's validate_script (validators.py) applies these to a GENERATED script; the platform's paste box (platform/src/lib/editPaste.ts validateScript) applies them to a PASTED one, which skips the script stage. Asserted by worker/tests/test_edit_hints.py and platform/test/editPaste.test.ts. `expect` are substrings of the violations; an empty list means the text must pass.

cases.name: plain narration passes
cases.text: Número cinco, o genkan. A sujeira da rua fica ali, e não anda pela casa.

cases.name: an accented word between asterisks is still italics
cases.text: O nome dele era *Alcedo*, e ninguém lembrou.
expect: markdown italics — the asterisks are spoken by the TTS — found '*Alcedo*'

cases.name: a heading
cases.text:
# Parte um
O Brasil começou assim.
